title: PPG-MS4 — Fleet Coverage (21 JM Die machines: 7 Okuma lathes, 5 mills, 3 EDM, 6 support)
description: Delivers production-grade master posts for every JM Die machine in production. Inherits sidecar (PPG-MS0), block-by-block S/F (PPG-MS1), and iMachining (PPG-MS2). Closes the Roku-Roku alias bug found in pre-precompact audit, adds Multus B250IIW lathe-mill combo, and ships the fleet manifest doc that operators read on day one of cutover.
rationale: JM Die has 21 machines but PRISM has only wired 3 (Hurco V11, Okuma B250, Mitsubishi MV1200R). The other 18 fall back to manual editing, which is the failure mode that triggered this entire roadmap. Without fleet coverage, JM-PRODUCTION-CUTOVER cannot ship.
leverage_existing: PPG-WIRE-MS0 — Hurco V11, Okuma B250, Mitsubishi MV1200R already wired
JM Die profile — src/data/jm-die-profile.ts (controller map, 100+ customers)
Master post engines registry — extended per machine family

the_worked_example_that_proves_it.scenario: JM Die programmer needs to run a Multus B250IIW (lathe-mill) job for an Optimas fastener that touches 4 of the 21 machines (lathe → wire EDM → mill → grinder).
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.today_pre_ppg_ms4: Lathe and wire EDM posts work (PPG-WIRE-MS0). Mill is hand-coded. Grinder is hand-coded. Multus is hand-coded. The Roku-Roku alias bug means even if the operator picks Roku-Roku from the wizard, the wrong dialect emits.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.should_be_post_ppg_ms4: Wizard shows 21 machines accurately. Selecting any of them produces a correct, physics-aware program. Multi-machine job is sequenced; each post sized to that machine's controller and kinematics.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.gap_now_closed: JM Die can run PRISM-generated programs on every CNC in the shop without human post-editing.

layer_boundary_note: MasterPostEngine = machine-level (Hurco V11, Okuma B250, etc). DialectEmitterEngine = controller-level (Fanuc, WinMax, OSP, etc). MS4 builds the former and CONSUMES the latter from MS5. PostDialectRouter is BUILT in PPG-MS5 (U-PPGM42c) — U-PPGM34 here is a CONSUMER patch only.
